name: metaball-lava-lamp
title: Metaball Lava Lamp
description: Rising and falling viscous wax liquid metaball blobs floating smoothly inside a heated column.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Retro
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Airy
Shape: Soft
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Neon On Dark

## Rules

- Passive Canvas Lava: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
